t: You're looking at Harrods, the huge luxury department store on Brompton Road in Knightsbridge. The building you see opened in 1905, designed by C. W. Stephens for Charles Digby Harrod. It replaced the first store on this ground, founded by his father, Charles Henry Harrod, in 1849, which burned down in 1881. Charles Henry was a merchant who built the business that still carries his name. Today it's the largest department store in Europe, with around 15 million visitors a year, and the building is Grade II* listed.
